crafted.explained: FP: ISO 10303-21 requires `*` in a slot a subtype redeclares as DERIVE (IfcGeometricRepresentationSubContext.CoordinateSpaceDimension). IfcOpenShell does not report a value written there; the corpus file subcontext-explicit-derived.ifc shows it.

all.explained: FP: ISO 10303-21 requires `*` in a slot a subtype redeclares as DERIVE (IfcGeometricRepresentationSubContext.CoordinateSpaceDimension). IfcOpenShell does not report a value written there; the corpus file subcontext-explicit-derived.ifc shows it.

FP: The rule tests `WorldCoordinateSystem :<>: ...`, instance inequality (ISO 10303-11 12.2.2). IfcOpenShell compiles it to `!=` under compare_instances_by_value, so two distinct but equal-valued placements skip the precision check. We keep instance semantics: the two contexts carry precisions $ and 1E-5.
